format: start-up Visiting Angels franchise (non-medical home care office), Protected Territory of up to 325,000 population (standard 200,000)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Visiting Angels franchise is $125,460.00 to $171,150.00. This includes $51,950.00 to $89,950.00 that must be paid to the franchisor or affiliate.

fee.quote: pay an Initial Franchise Fee to us ranging from $51,950.00 to $89,950.00 (amount varies based on size of territory) when they sign the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee is $64,950.00 for a Protected Territory of 200K population.
fee.note: $51,950 for territories up to 100,000 population; $64,950 (Standard Franchise) for 100,000-200,000; $89,950 for 325,000; proportionately higher above. Buyers of an existing franchise (transfer) pay $15,950 to $49,950 depending on territory population.

royalty.basis: gross revenues (collected receipts, including caregiver wages)
royalty.quote: Royalty/Gross Monthly Service Fee 3.5% of total Gross Revenues; 3.25% after $125,000.00 per month revenues are reached; 3.0% after $225,000.00 per month are reached. Minimum $495.00 ($625.00/month in 325K pop. territory) by 2nd month after training

adFund.quote: Cooperative Advertising $425.00 per month ($575.00/month in 325K pop. territory) or 2.5% of your Gross Revenues if higher; 2.25% of Gross Revenues after $150,000.00 per month revenues are reached if higher; 2.0% of Gross Revenues after $250,000.00 per month revenues are reached if higher
adFund.note: Greater of a monthly minimum ($425, rising to $550 in month 24, $750 in month 48, $895 in month 60; higher in 325K territories) or 2.5% of Gross Revenues (2.25% above $150,000/month, 2.0% above $250,000/month).

otherRecurring.name: Minimum Gross Service Fee (royalty floor)
otherRecurring.amount: Minimum $495.00 per month by 2nd month after training; $650.00 in the 24th month; $875.00 in the 48th month; $1,095.00 per month in the 60th month (higher in 325K pop. territory)

transferFee.amount: Transferring Franchisee: $9,500.00 to $25,000.00 or 2.5% of sale price, if greater; based on sale price. Purchasing Franchisee: $15,950.00 for up to 325K population ... $49,950.00 for above 1.25M population.

item19.note: Revenue (collected receipts, including caregiver wages) only, in ranges; no average, median or costs. Includes franchisees that opened or closed during 2025 even if they operated only part of the year; excludes those that had not attended training by October 2025.

special: Royalty and cooperative advertising are each the greater of a percentage of Gross Revenues or a monthly minimum that steps up with time (royalty minimum $495 rising to $1,095 per month by month 60; ad minimum $425 rising to $895). Gross Revenues include the wages paid to caregivers, so fees apply to a labor-heavy revenue base. Royalty percentage declines to 3.25% above $125,000 and 3.0% above $225,000 of monthly revenue.
issues: Item 19 gives only a range distribution, so headline value and median are null. excludesRealEstate is null: Item 7 has a $5,000 'Deposits, Insurances, Licenses, Lease' line but no real estate purchase. Transfer fee usd is the transferring franchisee's minimum ($9,500, or 2.5% of sale price if greater).
